relationships.englishTerm: Self
relationships.dialectNote: Bilateral relationship; shared across paternal and maternal lines in most dialects.
relationships.notes: The referent person; the point of origin from which all kinship paths are traced; a core family member in Chinese kinship

relationships.englishTerm: Father
relationships.dialectNote: Distinguished by paternal lineage across dialects; Hokkien and Hakka may preserve older distinction patterns.
relationships.notes: Father; called 爸爸 (bàba) informally

relationships.englishTerm: Mother
relationships.dialectNote: Distinguished by maternal lineage across dialects; Mandarin and Cantonese use distinct terms for maternal vs paternal relatives.
relationships.notes: Mother; called 妈妈 (māmā) informally

relationships.englishTerm: Elder Brother
relationships.dialectNote: Sichuanese does not grammatically distinguish elder/younger for this relationship; context and honorifics convey the distinction.
